name: Stablecoin net-flow surge -> forward buying pressure (BTC/ETH, fast hold)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: net minting of stablecoins into exchange-visible supply is genuine fresh fiat entering the crypto perimeter (GENIUS Act 2025 institutionalized this: +$100B / +49% stablecoin supply in 2025). A large positive stablecoin_net_flow_usd is dry powder that must eventually chase a risk asset -> a leading nowcast of spot demand BEFORE it hits the order book. The counterparty is market makers and OTC desks who see the mint but have not yet deployed; the edge is the deployment lag. Fed/BIS 2025 work confirms stablecoin flows move even T-bill yields, so the flow is economically real, not noise. Entry: stablecoin_net_flow_usd above a fitted surge threshold; go long, hold 3-10d, exit on flow normalizing back down or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1 (biggest death risk): Kaiko/Glassnode 2024-25 flag flow/price correlation < 0.3 at 1-3d horizons -> KILL unless the top flow-quintile forward return dominates the bottom quintile monotonically with DSR>=0.95. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the signal is COINCIDENT (flow spikes AT the top, not before) it is useless -> require a positive forward predictive coefficient at lead k>=1 surviving BH-FDR. DISCONFIRMER 3: flow that funds shorts/arb collateral rather than spot longs is the null; if it dominates, kill. Net of ~20bps round-trip.
catalyst: large stablecoin net-mint (dry powder) not yet deployed to spot
